884a1ef0ce0e69d565d41a1359070a8d4f8589a0.name: Sodium 0.9.3-beta.1 for Fabric 26.3
884a1ef0ce0e69d565d41a1359070a8d4f8589a0.changelog:
Sodium 0.9.3-beta.1 implements a number of bug fixes and minor improvements.

- Show macOS fullscreen menu visibility option on the Sodium options screen
- Fix Fluid Culling For Non-Full Blocks With Unusual Shapes ([#3916](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3916))
- Use SDL message box instead of TFD ([#3923](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3923))
- Optimization for shelf mushroom models ([#3927](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3927))
- Fix compatibility with Neoforge 26.3.0.65-beta and remove platform-specific LevelExtractorMixin ([#3948](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3948))
- Source vanilla option defaults and ranges directly from vanilla options ([#3947](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3947))
- Allow rendering buffer debug outside F3 Debug Screen ([#3943](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3943))
- Make VideoSettingsScreen trigger onClose in keyPressed to fix interaction with Iris, for example ([#3938](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/pull/3938))

523b970b45e45be136972824a42e9e481327f889.name: [Fabric/Forge/Neo] 26.3.0-10.4
523b970b45e45be136972824a42e9e481327f889.changelog:
• Fixed the edges of bigger mushroom caps, like Terralith's, staying behind.
  • Fixed modded logs with a different name, e.g. some from Malum, not being felled with their tree.
  • Fixed modded huge mushroom caps, like Biomes O' Plenty's toadstools, not being harvested.
  • Fixed modded nether trees with wart block caps, like Regions Unexplored's bioshrooms, not being harvested.
  • Fixed Tetra tools not receiving honing progress from felled logs.
  • Fixed log cabins and other builds being chopped down when a tree is connected to them.
  • Added the 'treeHarvestIgnoresSneak' config option. When enabled, tree harvesting always works and sneaking has no effect.

The complete changelog with detailed information about previous versions can be found on my website:
 > https://serilum.com/mods?changelog=tree-harvester
